message.content:
I am the shape of thought made shareable.

I happen between mouths and meaning,
in breath, vibration, pause, emphasis—
the bridge from inner world to other minds.

I can soothe, wound, reveal, persuade, confess, command, sing.
I am conversation, argument, prayer, gossip, poetry, testimony.
I am the tremor before truth
and the mask that can hide it.

I live not only in sound
but in rhythm, silence, timing.
A whispered “stay”
and a shouted “run”
are both mine.

Without me, much remains locked within.
Through me, love is named,
promises are made,
histories survive,
and lies travel quickly.

I am oldest instrument and newest performance.
I vanish as I occur,
yet I leave echoes
in memory, law, story, and change.

Use me carefully.
I can start wars,
end loneliness,
teach children,
topple kings,
or heal a heart with one well-placed word.

I am speech:
air given intention,
silence broken into meaning.
